newsitem.title: USA: Revlon unit signs $750 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Revlon unit signs $750 mln credit facility.

text.p: Revlon Consumer Products Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary of Revlon Inc, said Tuesday that it had signed a $750 million credit agreement.
Revlon said the proceeds will be used to refinance, at lower interest rates and on more favorable terms, its existing facility and to redeem Revlon's 10-7/8 percent Sinking Fund Debentures due 2010.
The company said it expects to record an extraordinary item related to the early extinguishment of debt of about $15 million in the second quarter.
Revlon indicated that it expected to redeem the Debentures on or about July 15, 1997.
